description: The upstream-generated raw parameter values are preserved as the immutable pre-calibration baseline.
source_or_reason: Needed to distinguish structural build work from later calibration.
review_need: Never overwrite the raw baseline; create dated calibrated versions.

description: The model horizon is 2021–2050.
source_or_reason: Country configuration selected during the raw build.
review_need: Add 2020 or document its use as an initialization year before the historical backcast.

description: Wet season is November–April and dry season is May–October.
source_or_reason: Fiji country adaptation in config.yaml.
review_need: Validate against Fiji hydro and rainfall behavior; preserve monthly evidence.

description: Each season is represented by one daytime and one nighttime slice.
source_or_reason: Four-slice tractability choice inherited by the Fiji build.
review_need: Test whether more slices are required for the stated renewable-pathway use.

description: Fiji is represented as one national electricity node FJIXX.
source_or_reason: OSeMOSYS Global country-node structure.
review_need: Replace with separate island systems before claiming Fiji operational fidelity.

description: The national land system is represented by four agro-climatic clusters.
source_or_reason: Country workflow clustering choice.
review_need: Test sensitivity and retain cluster diagnostics if the count changes.

description: The modeled land-cell domain is normalized to 18,273 km2.
source_or_reason: Government of Fiji area evidence and antimeridian-safe spatial processing.
review_need: Reconcile land/water boundary conventions before official accounting use.

description: GAEZ RCP4.5 layers represent crop and water climate conditions.
source_or_reason: Selected country-workflow climate pathway.
review_need: Treat as a scenario choice rather than observed 2020–2024 weather.

description: Taro and other starchy roots are represented through the GAEZ yam proxy; non-explicit crops are aggregated as OTH.
source_or_reason: Available GAEZ layers and tractable crop grouping.
review_need: Review against Fiji crop statistics before commodity-specific policy analysis.

description: Crop-yield factors are fixed at the neutral value one.
source_or_reason: Historical yield fitting was deliberately removed from the raw build.
review_need: Estimate transparent multi-year drivers during calibration; do not fit one output year by lock.

description: OSeMOSYS Global Fiji energy values are retained without historical scaling or generation locks.
source_or_reason: Preserves an unforced comparator.
review_need: Replace global defaults only with traceable Fiji evidence or declared calibration parameters.

description: The raw configuration prohibits new investment in CCG, COA, COG, CSP, GEO, OCG, OTH, WAV, WOF, and URN.
source_or_reason: Country applicability choice in config.yaml.
review_need: Document evidence for every technology retained or excluded before scenario analysis.

description: The generic OHC → DEMINDOHC → INDOHC branch is excluded from active Fiji v2.
source_or_reason: The generated branch had no OHC producer or importer, no INDOHC demand, and no Fiji-specific cost, capacity, availability, or emissions data; UNSD 2020–2024 data contain no SIEC 4500 observations for Fiji.
review_need: Ask Fiji Bureau of Statistics, FRCS, and major industrial users whether any material combustible petroleum product is missing before introducing a defined useful-energy service and supply chain.

description: A 0.05 discount rate is inserted during MUIO import because the generated CLEWs Global input is empty.
source_or_reason: Explicitly documented import choice; not a Fiji-specific estimate.
review_need: Replace with an analysis-specific social or financial rate and sensitivity range before cost comparisons.

description: The reserve-capacity proxy uses a reserve margin of 1.0 when the generated ReserveMargin table is empty.
source_or_reason: Ports the generated capacity-credit test without inventing a policy margin.
review_need: Select and source a Fiji planning reserve margin before adequacy-related use.

description: Observed demand, fleet, weather, fuel prices, and documented outages may be supplied as exogenous historical conditions; generation, fuel use, renewable share, and emissions remain test outputs.
source_or_reason: Separates legitimate historical conditions from forced outcomes.
review_need: Classify every calibration datum as exogenous condition, endogenous target, or history-fixed result.

description: 2020–2022 will be used for parameter calibration and 2023–2024 will be held out for validation, subject to evidence alignment.
source_or_reason: Provides a genuine out-of-sample test with the currently identified evidence.
review_need: Do not use held-out outcomes for tuning; record any later exception as a protocol change.

description: The documented 2021 aggregate hydro, thermal, wind, and grid-supplying biomass fleet is held constant over 2020–2024; new generation investment is blocked in those years.
source_or_reason: A complete public annual unit commissioning and retirement register was not found; the 2021 official fleet is the strongest consistent anchor.
review_need: Replace with an annual unit register when available; the structural grid conduit PWRTRNFJIXX is excluded from the investment block.

description: EFL total generation including IPP purchases is used as the annual ELCFJIXX02 supply requirement.
source_or_reason: The one-node model has no explicit station-use or network-loss accounting; gross grid supply is the boundary that aligns with generation categories.
review_need: Do not claim demand reproduction; add explicit losses and customer-demand accounting in a later release.

description: A single effective biomass/IPP availability factor was estimated from mean 2020–2022 IPP generation and the documented 34 MW fleet, then frozen.
source_or_reason: This was the prior aggregate proxy before cane, bagasse and wood-residue generation were separated.
review_need: Retained for baseline reconstruction only; do not apply it to the active split technologies.

description: A low 2020–2024 wind availability ceiling is estimated from mean 2020–2022 output and the documented 9.8 MW Butoni fleet; the inherited value returns from 2025 as an assumed repaired state.
status: Active Fiji v2 calibration and future assumption
source_or_reason: Butoni was severely affected by Tropical Cyclone Harold and remained a documented claim/repair issue; public annual output is extremely small.
review_need: Calibration-period wind output is H and held-out output is E; percentage errors are not materiality-stable below 1 GWh.

description: Hydro keeps the inherited wet/dry capacity-factor shape and 0.9 availability without fitting to EFL generation.
source_or_reason: Preserves an independently testable hydro result after correcting only the documented installed capacity.
review_need: Add observed inflow, rainfall, reservoir, and outage drivers rather than tuning to the 2023–2024 generation outcomes.

description: From 2025, the raw electricity-demand trajectory is rebased to observed 2024 grid supply and corrected residual-capacity paths preserve raw retirement ratios.
status: Superseded for electricity demand by Phase 1C; residual-capacity rule remains active
source_or_reason: Avoided an artificial 2025 discontinuity while preserving the raw growth and retirement shapes.
review_need: Retained as the Phase 1B accounting-control trajectory; Phase 1C uses documented sector projections.

description: Public-water service is billed household, government, commercial and carted-water delivery reported by the Fiji Bureau of Statistics.
source_or_reason: This matches delivered public supply while keeping purification and distribution losses on the raw-water input side.
review_need: Reconcile unbilled authorized consumption and any non-WAF public supply before broader water-account claims.

description: Annual public-water demand is allocated to time slices in proportion to YearSplit.
source_or_reason: Only annual water evidence was retained; a flat annual delivery rate is neutral at the current four-slice resolution.
review_need: Replace with seasonal or monthly demand evidence when available.

description: The public-groundwater route and its abstraction layer are capped at zero through 2050.
source_or_reason: The 2020–2024 WAF table reports surface abstraction and no Fiji-specific public-groundwater source share or pumping coefficient was retained.
review_need: Activate only with source, availability, energy-intensity and emissions evidence.

description: No explicit public-water pumping/treatment electricity input is added in Phase 1B.
source_or_reason: No Fiji-specific intensity was found and gross national grid supply already includes water-sector electricity, so an added input without residual-demand adjustment would double count it.
review_need: Estimate water-sector electricity and reconcile it out of residual grid demand before endogenizing pumping or treatment.

description: Inherited AGR/COM/IND/RES/TRA output carriers are treated as sector final-energy interfaces, not as useful-service commodities.
status: Approved design rule; not yet an active parameter
source_or_reason: The inherited energy adapters were not joined to country-specific appliance, process, vehicle or useful-service demands.
review_need: Add a useful-service layer only where demand magnitude and conversion evidence pass the carrier register's activation gate.

description: Sector electricity demand replaces components of direct ELCFJIXX02 demand only when their sum plus losses and an explicit residual equals the gross grid-supply requirement.
source_or_reason: FBoS provides 2020-2024 customer use, household own generation and distribution losses; the accounting checkpoint proves parity with the previous gross boundary.
review_need: Maintain exact annual reconciliation whenever another electricity-using sector is activated.

description: Household or population stove shares are not treated as fuel-energy shares or useful cooking-energy demand.
status: Approved evidence rule; no active cooking demand
source_or_reason: The Fiji MICS identifies the technology mix but contains no annual PJ magnitude or conversion-efficiency set.
review_need: Obtain a defensible cooking-service magnitude, efficiencies, fuel-stacking treatment, biomass boundary, electricity allocation and biogas convention before activation.

description: Commercial grid electricity grows 2.6% annually after 2024, rebased to the observed 2024 quantity.
source_or_reason: Government of Fiji LEDS BAU-unconditional commercial electricity assumption.
review_need: Parameterize LEDS conditional/high-ambition 2.0% growth and ±10% uncertainty as later scenarios.

description: Industrial grid electricity grows 2.0% annually after 2024, rebased to the observed 2024 quantity.
source_or_reason: Government of Fiji LEDS uses 2.0% industrial grid-electricity growth across its base scenarios.
review_need: Test industry-specific activity and grid-connection assumptions when data become available.

description: Central-grid residential demand follows a 2024-normalized household/appliance stock index using household growth, urbanization, urban/rural grid access, appliance uptake and MEPS efficiency turnover.
source_or_reason: Government of Fiji LEDS household structure and Fiji MICS 2021 central-grid access rates.
review_need: Add uncertainty, updated household projections, sector load shapes and explicit end-use service quantities.

description: Post-2024 direct ELCFJIXX02 demand equals 11.9232103418% of commercial, industrial and residential end use.
source_or_reason: The factor is the observed/calculated 2024 loss-plus-residual quantity divided by 2024 sector end use.
review_need: Separate network loss from station use and boundary residual when independent projections are available.

description: All four electricity demand components use the inherited normalized aggregate four-slice profile.
source_or_reason: No Fiji sector-specific load profiles were retained; using the same profile preserves the accounting-checkpoint peak exactly.
review_need: Replace with measured sector profiles and rerun the aggregate reserve-proxy check.

description: The documented 34 MW grid-supplying biomass stock is represented as 25 MW FSC bagasse cogeneration and 9 MW Tropik Wood residue generation.
source_or_reason: The Government of Fiji REI Investment Plan identifies FSC Lautoka 5 MW, FSC Labasa 20 MW and Tropik Wood 9 MW.
review_need: Replace the inherited retirement profile with a unit-level commissioning and retirement register when available.

description: FSC cane crushed is the processed-cane service demand for 2020–2024; raw CRPSGC is an intermediate measured in million tonnes.
source_or_reason: FSC annual operating tables report physical tonnes of cane crushed; the upstream generator divides FAOSTAT crop production by 1,000,000.
review_need: Sugar and molasses are retained as checks but are not yet separate model outputs.

description: After 2024, processed cane follows the inherited SSP-shaped cane path rebased to the FSC 2024 actual.
source_or_reason: This removes the inherited 2024 level discontinuity while preserving its post-2024 shape.
review_need: Replace with an FSC or agriculture-sector cane outlook and test uncertainty.

description: Exportable bagasse generation uses the IRENA 42 bar, 400°C, 500 kg process-steam-per-tonne-cane, no-straw case of 25.4 kWh exported per tonne cane.
source_or_reason: No retained Fiji mill-level steam-cycle and parasitic-load dataset was found; the selected IRENA case explicitly accounts for process steam.
review_need: Test the full IRENA range and replace with Fiji mill heat-and-power balances when available.

description: Wood-residue generation is bounded by the mean 2020–2022 residual after subtracting calculated bagasse export from aggregate EFL IPP purchases.
used_for: Wood-residue availability and annual resource cap
source_or_reason: EFL reports aggregate IPP purchases rather than separate FSC and Tropik output; calibration uses only 2020–2022 and is frozen for 2023–2024.
review_need: Obtain plant-level Tropik Wood generation, residue supply and outage records; do not tune this bound to held-out years.

description: The Phase 1D accounting control uses an artificial 10 PJ exportable-bagasse output per million tonnes cane solely to keep the diagnostic resource nonbinding.
source_or_reason: The control isolates the structural stock split from physical resource coefficients across the complete horizon.
review_need: Never use the diagnostic ratio in the physical case or a scenario result.
